To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a new deep Multiple Instance Learning method that is trained end-to-end, that can be applied to any dataset that has a bag-instance structure, that can learn instance representation, and that outperforms other methods on standard Multiple Instance Learning benchmarks and other end-to-end trained methods on end-to-end trained datasets.

(i) our method can be trained end to end to perform bag classification; (ii) it can be used for instance classification and weighting; (iii) our Gaussian weighting function is effective and robust; and (iv) our instance weighting stream can be used as a regularizer in instance representation learning.

1) Gaussian radial basis function can be used as an instance weighting function to regularize instance representation learning in a deep multiple instance learning method; 2) Our proposed deep MIL method can be trained end to end to perform bag classification and instance classification.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following: (1) How to learn the instance representation in an end-to-end manner? (2) How to learn instance weighting functions? (3) What is the role of the instance representation in the bag classification? (4) How to learn a robust instance representation?
the development of a deep MIL model for end-to-end instance classification and weighting that can be trained with weak supervision.
two main contributions.

our proposed method is able to learn instance representations and weights that are more robust and discriminative, and hence achieve better classification results.
our method is able to achieve state of the art performance on all datasets.

the Gaussian instance weighting can help regularize the instance representation learning and improve the overall performance.
the Gaussian instance weighting can be a powerful regularizer for deep MIL models.

the Gaussian instance weighting can help to regularize the MIL training and improve the performance.
